Description: Set up development infrastructure including certificate management, Prometheus monitoring, and plugin navigation integration. This epic covers all foundational work needed before UI development can begin.
Provide UI for cluster administrators to create, list, and view BrokerService resources. BrokerServices represent messaging infrastructure (clusters, storage, PKI) managed by operators.
Provide UI for cluster administrators to create, list, and view BrokerApp resources. BrokerApps represent application intent and bind to BrokerServices via label selectors.
Display performance metrics for BrokerServices and BrokerApps using Prometheus queries and charts. Enables cluster administrators to monitor messaging infrastructure health.
